query: SELECT id AS "id!", template_id AS "template_id!", at AS "at!", subject_ids AS "subject_ids!", email AS "email!" FROM ( SELECT o.id, o.template_id, coalesce((SELECT min(d.received_at) FROM messaging.delivery_event d WHERE d.provider_sid = o.provider_sid AND d.status = 'delivered'), o.sent_at, o.created_at) AS at, o.subject_ids, o.created_at AS queued, false AS email FROM messaging.outbox o WHERE o.recipient_id = $1 AND $2 = ANY(o.subject_ids) AND o.template_id = ANY($3::text[]) AND o.status NOT IN ('blocked', 'failed', 'expired') UNION ALL SELECT e.id, substr(e.template_id, length($6) + 1), coalesce((SELECT min(v.event_at) FROM messaging.email_event v WHERE v.provider_id = e.provider_id AND v.kind = 'email.delivered'), e.sent_at, e.queued_at), e.subject_ids, e.queued_at, true FROM messaging.email_outbox e WHERE e.recipient_id = $1 AND $2 = ANY(e.subject_ids) AND e.template_id = ANY($4::text[]) AND e.status <> 'dropped' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messaging.email_event v WHERE v.provider_id = e.provider_id AND v.kind = ANY($5::text[]))) u ORDER BY queued DESC, email ASC, id DESC LIMIT 1
